question: Why is the South's average daily rate lower this summer than last summer? We didn't cut prices.
answer:
**The average daily rate fell because of mix, not price. Like-for-like rates went up in every category, but the South rented far more low-rate power tools and fewer high-rate earthmoving and access items.**

**1. Rates rose in every category**

| Category | ADR FY2026 (EUR) | ADR FY2027 (EUR) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| ACC | 53.68 | 55.92 | +4.2% |
| EAR | 103.36 | 107.35 | +3.9% |
| PWT | 14.55 | 15.15 | +4.1% |
| PWL | 29.26 | 30.49 | +4.2% |
| CON | 22.44 | 23.35 | +4.1% |

This fits the South list price change on 2026-04-06, which covered all five categories. The weekly files are all loaded, so the data is complete.

**2. The mix moved toward cheap power tools**

| Category | Share of on-rent days FY2026 | Share FY2027 | On-rent days change |
|---|---|---|---|
| PWT | 41.6% | 51.5% | +42.7% |
| ACC | 17.3% | 12.7% | −15.2% |
| EAR | 10.7% | 6.9% | −25.8% |
| PWL | 12.5% | 10.9% | +1.3% |
| CON | 17.9% | 18.0% | +15.7% |

Power tools earn about EUR 15 per day, while earthmoving earns about EUR 107 and access about EUR 56. Adding about 10,000 power tool days while losing about 1,550 earthmoving days and 1,490 access days pulls the blended average down sharply.

**3. Size of each effect (ADR fell EUR 4.23, from 34.05 to 29.82)**
- **Price/rate effect: about +EUR 1.38.** FY2026's mix at FY2027 rates would give about 35.43.
- **Mix effect: about −EUR 5.61.** Moving from that 35.43 to the actual 29.82 is the cost of the change in mix.

**Revenue impact:** total revenue is up only 1.0% (EUR 1.92m to EUR 1.94m) even though on-rent days rose 15.4%. Earthmoving revenue fell by about EUR 142k (621k to 479k) and access by about EUR 61k. Power tools added about EUR 166k, and concrete and compaction about EUR 46k.

**What the data doesn't tell us**
- It doesn't show why power tool demand jumped or why earthmoving and access fell. Possible causes include fleet availability, a promotion, a large contract customer, a channel shift, or lost earthmoving business. These are worth checking by depot and channel.
- The staff notes (fire alarm test, car park repainting, heater stock, pressure washer servicing) don't explain any of this. Only one of them is even a South depot.
- The category rate increases are averages of about 4%. I can't tell from this data whether the full list price rise was realised or partly offset by discounting.
